questions.question: Review the crisis intervention steps in substance abuse situations.
questions.solution_html:
• Review the crisis intervention steps in substance abuse situations / - (5 marks)
  • a) Assessment of the situation – Identify the level of substance use, risk factors, and the person’s physical and
  • psychological condition.
  • b) Ensuring immediate safety – Protect the individual and others from harm and provide medical help if required.
  • c) Establishing rapport – Build trust through supportive and non-judgmental communication.
  • d) Providing emotional support and counselling – Help the person understand the consequences of substance
  • abuse and encourage healthier coping methods.
  • e) Referral and follow-up – Connect the individual to rehabilitation services, therapy, or support groups.
questions.final_answer: Option Assessment of the situation – Identify the level of substance use, risk factors, and the person’s physical and

questions.question: Describe the role of communication skills in Psychological First Aid.
questions.solution_html:
• a) Active listening helps survivors express their feelings and concerns freely.
  • b) Empathy and compassion help build trust between the helper and the survivor.
  • c) Clear and simple communication provides accurate information about available help and resources.
  • d) Non-verbal communication such as eye contact and calm body language provides reassurance.
  • e) Respectful communication supports dignity and cultural sensitivity.
questions.final_answer: Option Active listening helps survivors express their feelings and concerns freely.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Review the components of an effective crisis intervention plan.
questions.solution_html:
• Review the components of an effective crisis intervention plan. - U] / - (5 marks)
  •  Assessment of the crisis situation and identification of immediate needs.
  •  Goal setting to stabilize the individual and reduce emotional distress.
  •  Selection of appropriate intervention strategies such as counselling or practical assistance.
  •  Mobilization of support systems including family, community, and professional services.
  •  Evaluation and follow-up to ensure recovery and prevent further crises.

questions.question: Describe the concept of cultural competence in Psychological First Aid.
questions.solution_html:
•  Respect for cultural beliefs, values, and traditions of affected individuals.
  •  Awareness of cultural differences in emotional expression and coping methods.
  •  Use of culturally appropriate communication and language.
  •  Avoiding stereotypes and discrimination while providing support.
  •  Adapting interventions to suit the cultural background of survivors.
questions.final_answer:  Adapting interventions to suit the cultural background of survivors
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Describe the stages of crisis development.
questions.solution_html:
•  Initial stress or triggering event that disturbs the individual’s normal functioning.
  •  Increased tension and anxiety when usual coping strategies fail.
  •  Escalation of crisis where emotional distress and confusion increase.
  •  Breakdown or disorganization in thinking, behavior, and emotional control.
  •  Resolution phase, where the crisis is resolved either positively (adaptation) or negatively (maladjustment).
questions.final_answer:  Resolution phase, where the crisis is resolved either positively (adaptation) or negatively (maladjustment)
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Illustrate how non-verbal communication promotes safety and reassurance in / Psychological First Aid.
questions.solution_html:
• a) Maintaining calm body language helps reduce the survivor’s fear and anxiety.
  • b) Gentle facial expressions show empathy and understanding.
  • c) Appropriate eye contact builds trust and connection.
  • d) Nodding the head while listening shows attention and encouragement to speak.
  • e) Maintaining a respectful physical distance makes the survivor feel safe and comfortable.
  • f) Using a soft tone of voice helps create a calm environment.
  • g) Avoiding sudden movements or aggressive gestures prevents additional stress.
  • h) Offering supportive gestures such as guiding someone to a safe place when appropriate.
  • i) Open posture (uncrossed arms, relaxed stance) communicates acceptance and willingness to help.
  • j) Consistent non-verbal signals reinforce verbal reassurance and emotional support.
questions.final_answer: Option Maintaining calm body language helps reduce the survivor’s fear and anxiety.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Apply appropriate psychosocial support for families affected by displacement.
questions.solution_html:
• Apply appropriate psychosocial support for families affected by displacement. - / - (10 marks)
  •  Provide immediate emotional support and listen to the concerns of displaced family members.
  •  Ensure safety and basic needs such as food, shelter, and medical care.
  •  Help families reconnect with relatives or community members to strengthen social support.
  •  Encourage open communication among family members to share feelings and experiences.
  •  Provide information about available services such as relief programs and counselling.
  •  Support children through play, education, and structured activities to reduce stress.
  •  Promote coping strategies such as relaxation, prayer, or community participation.
  •  Respect cultural and religious practices while providing assistance.
  •  Encourage participation in community support groups for emotional recovery.
  •  Provide referral to professional mental health services when serious distress is observed.
questions.final_answer:  Provide referral to professional mental health services when serious distress is observed
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Contrast supportive and directive crisis intervention techniques with examples.
questions.solution_html:
• Contrast supportive and directive crisis intervention techniques with examples.- An] / (10 Marks)
  •  Supportive techniques focus on emotional support, while directive techniques focus on guiding actions.
  •  Supportive approach: listening and comforting the person during distress.
  •  Directive approach: giving clear instructions to manage the crisis situation.
  •  Supportive technique example: encouraging a disaster survivor to express feelings.
  •  Directive technique example: instructing a survivor to move to a safe shelter immediately.
  •  Supportive methods emphasize empathy, understanding, and reassurance.
  •  Directive methods emphasize problem-solving and decision making.
  •  Supportive techniques are often used when emotional distress is high.
  •  Directive techniques are useful when quick action is required for safety.
  •  Both approaches are often combined in crisis intervention for effective support[
questions.final_answer:  Both approaches are often combined in crisis intervention for effective support[
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Apply the RAPID model while assisting a flood-affected survivor.
questions.solution_html:
• Apply the RAPID model while assisting a flood-affected survivor / -(10 marks)
  •  Reflective Listening (R): Listen carefully to the survivor’s experiences and feelings about the flood.
  •  Assessment (A): Evaluate the person’s emotional state, safety needs, and immediate concerns.
  •  Prioritization (P): Identify urgent needs such as medical help, shelter, or family reunification.
  •  Intervention (I): Provide psychological support, practical assistance, and coping strategies.
  •  Disposition (D): Connect the survivor with appropriate support services or relief agencies.
  •  Provide reassurance and emotional comfort to reduce panic and distress.
  •  Help the survivor focus on immediate steps for safety and recovery.
  •  Encourage use of family or community support systems.
  •  Offer clear and accurate information about available resources and relief efforts.
  •  Follow up or refer the survivor for additional mental health support if needed.
questions.final_answer: Option : Evaluate the person’s emotional state, safety needs, and immediate concerns.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026
